title: Native grouping
text: Enhances a native fieldset, keeping its controls in place and its built-in group semantics.

title: Legend and help
text: A styled legend that can be visually hidden, plus group help text read with the group.

title: Group-level error
text: One error message for the whole group, for checks no single control can make.

title: Disable in one step
text: The native disabled state turns off every control inside the group.
